## Biography

The Sanguineous Rim is a galactic region on the fringes of the Milky Way. In July 3312, Vista Genomics launched an exploration initiative there in partnership with Faulcon DeLacy, using the new Nomad ship-launched vessel to test its capabilities in extreme terrain and gather biological samples to assess genetic diversity beyond the core systems. The initiative was subsequently deemed a success, with pilots confirming that the Nomad's Mk II Biological Scanner and Mk II Sensor made exobiology sampling more efficient.
